subject: Trial Cofunding & Credit Escrow for Accelerator Cohort
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@launchforge.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com
Cc: Ava Simmons <ava@launchforge.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot co-funding + credits — quick proposal

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team loved the latency profiles and the rollout controls. LaunchForge is putting together an accelerator cohort this winter and we'd like Redwood to be the inference partner for a 6-week trial for 8 portfolio companies.

High-level ask: can LaunchForge co-fund the pilot (we'd put up $20k USD) and Redwood provide a matching promo credit pool? On our side we'd like the credits to be escrowed and released to startups based on consumption and a short set of success criteria (uptime > 99%, >= 10k tokens consumed, basic prompt-safety checks).

Attached is a short term-sheet and a proposed subsidy schedule — nothing formal, just to get the ball rolling. Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 1) hold credits in escrow, 2) invoice/recognize co-funding split, and 3) commit to a 30-day release window after pilot completion?

If helpful I can loop in our finance lead (Ava).

Thanks,
Liam

Attachments: proposed-subsidy-schedule.pdf, credit-escrow-term-sheet.docx

--
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships | LaunchForge Labs
liam@launchforge.com | +1 415-555-0142
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@launchforge.com>
Cc: Ava Simmons <ava@launchforge.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot co-funding + credits — quick proposal

Hi Liam — really appreciate the clear ask and the term-sheet. Short answer: we can support a co-funded pilot and we have mechanisms to partition promo credits, but escrow and recognition need a quick ops/finance check. Looping in Ben (sales ops) for partner/pricing detail and copying our pilot programs lead internally for the HUD on success criteria.

Next steps I propose:
- Ben, can you confirm the mechanics for escrowed credits (how Redwood would track & release) and any accounting implications?
- Ben/Marissa, can you propose a split model (e.g., sponsor covers X% of compute, Redwood provides Y% in promo credits) that balances risk and signal to startups?
- Liam/Ava, any flexibility on the release triggers? We may need to tighten the success metrics to something product-measurable.

I can turnaround a draft SOW + small addendum for co-funding within 48 hours once we land the mechanics.

Thanks — Rachel

--
Rachel Kim

rachel_kim@redwood.com | (650) 555-0202
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot co-funding + credits — quick proposal

Rachel / team — quick internal read: we can operationalize this without a full product change. Key notes: 

1) Escrow mechanics: Finance can create a promo-credit ledger entry scoped to LaunchForge / deal DL-48721. Credits are non-refundable and expire after 90 days unless otherwise agreed. For escrow release we recommend a 30-day verification window post-pilot during which we validate consumption & health signals.

2) Suggested pricing ladder (starter suggestion):
   - Sponsor (LaunchForge) pays $20k cash upfront covering baseline infra & support; Redwood offers matching $15k in promo credits (60/40 split) for first 8 companies (apportioned per-company or pooled).
   - If cohort consumption exceeds 150% of the projected token volume, Redwood proposes an overage rate at a 20% discount vs standard list for the remainder of the 90-day window.

3) Success metrics: agree on a minimal, product-measurable checklist: uptime >= 99% for endpoints, average 95th percentile latency < 200ms at projected qps, and no high-severity safety events. The product team can sign-off on telemetry queries to validate.

4) Accounting / recognition: Redwood recognizes revenue on the cash portion at invoicing; promo credits are contra-revenue (marketing expense) — legal/finance recommended a short SOW and a partner addendum to avoid confusion on refunds.

5) Doc/process: Attach term-sheet edits and I can have a draft SOW + addendum ready tomorrow. Priyom, can you confirm the wording for the escrow language (especially exit paths if the pilot is canceled)?

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Sales, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@launchforge.com>
Cc: Ava Simmons <ava@launchforge.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot co-funding + credits — quick proposal

Hi Liam / Ava — thanks for the proposal and for the patience while we checked internal ops. Short summary of what Redwood can commit to for the LaunchForge cohort: 

1) Credit split & amounts: LaunchForge pays $20k up-front. Redwood will allocate $15k in promo credits scoped to the cohort (apportioned per company unless you prefer a pooled balance). That is a 60/40 credit-to-cash ratio in Redwood's support of the pilot.

2) Escrow & release: Redwood will hold the $15k promo pool in an internal escrow ledger tied to deal DL-48721. After the 6-week pilot completes, there will be a 30-day verification window where our ops team validates the agreed metrics. Credits will be released to startups (or applied to invoices for each startup) once the verification succeeds. If the pilot is canceled before completion, unused promo credits return to Redwood unless LaunchForge requests a reallocation in writing.

3) Success metrics: to make validation straightforward we propose the following minimal triggers: 
   - endpoint uptime >= 99% during pilot windows;
   - cohort aggregate consumption >= 10k tokens per startup or 80k tokens pooled;
   - no product-blocking safety incidents.

4) Overage & extended usage: if the cohort exceeds the projected consumption by 150% we will offer a discounted overage rate (20% off list) for the remainder of the 90-day measurement period.

5) Next steps: Attached is an updated term-sheet and a short SOW addendum reflecting the escrow language. Please review and if acceptable we will send the DocuSign for signature (link included below). Once countersigned, Redwood will invoice LaunchForge the $20k and set the credit ledger live.

We aimed to keep the mechanics simple to avoid billing friction for the startups in the cohort. Happy to adjust the apportioned vs pooled approach depending on how you plan to distribute the credits.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/transaction/ABC-123-DFG
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/LaunchForge

Appreciate the partnership — let me know if you want a quick call to walk through the SOW.

Best,
Rachel
